annotations.title: A declared format’s rows, drawn as the app draws them

description: Shows the person one declared format as the app draws it — its table, its list (one line per row, a tick, grouped as `arrange_views view:list` says), or its board, roadmap or ready-to-start list when the format has one; or the agenda, every dated format’s rows from today; or a dashboard (no `format`: the document’s) — in the conversation, in a client that draws MCP Apps; the answer’s first line says whether this client said it draws them. Call it when they ask to see a format, or some of its rows: `match` and `search` filter exactly as `format_rows` does, and the view draws only those rows and says it is filtered. The text answer names every row the view shows, with its state or lane. The page is a read-only copy, drawn again as the file changes. Reads the file; never modifies it.

columns.description: Columns its lines draw, by format: `{unit:[title,state]}`. A roadmap’s `match` takes `unit.state`.

format.description: The declared format, by name. `formats` lists them. The agenda takes none.

match.description: Column name to the value it must equal. Text and enum columns match without regard to case; money or a quantity, a range: `10..50 ILS`. A list is any of them (`[planned, in_progress]`; a list column holding any), `{not: x}` or `{not: [a, b]}` none (empty passes), `null` empty. A date takes `today`, `yesterday`, `tomorrow`, `before|after today`, `within|last 14 days`, `this|last|next week|month|year`.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

search.description: A substring, in every column as shown but yes/no.

view.description: table, board, list, roadmap, ready, agenda (default table), dashboard, or a saved view’s name.
